prompts.description: Choose a storage backend for managing and tracking scratch org pools

choices.title: gitProvider
choices.description: Use a "Scratch Orgs Pool Dashboard" of your git provider (issue, work item or Pull Request). Scratch org credentials are encrypted.

choices.description: Use a custom object on a Salesforce org (usually DevHub) to store scratch org pool tech info

choices.title: localtest
choices.description: Writes in a local file (just for tests, can not work in CI)

message.message: Configuring the scratch org pool: storage gitProvider, 5 scratch orgs at most
Create a masked CI/CD variable named SFDX_HARDIS_POOL_ENCRYPTION_KEY with this value, and keep it in a safe place (it is displayed only once): <copy>q7Lx2HeLiOSdemoPoolKeyNotReal0123456789abc</copy>
Scratch org pool dashboard is ready: https://github.com/helios-energy/salesforce/issues/131
You need to define CI masked variable SFDX_AUTH_URL_DEV_HUB = force://PlatformCLI::(your-refresh-token)@helios-solar.my.salesforce.com
